name: NICE CG128 — autism recognition, referral and diagnosis in under 19s
description: NICE clinical guideline covering recognition, referral and diagnostic assessment of autism in children and young people under 19.
intended_use: Inspect professional guidance on child and young-person autism recognition, referral and diagnostic assessment without treating the guideline as a local access route.
audience_or_context: Children and young people, families, supporters and professionals using NICE guidance in England and Wales.
limitations: NICE guidance describes professional clinical practice and does not by itself establish the local referral pathway or waiting time.
Local services determine operational access arrangements within the applicable health system.
conflicts_of_interest: NICE develops national health and care guidance; ND Oracle lists the official guideline without treating inclusion as evidence about any local service's performance.

provenance.method: Current NICE CG128 route and diagnostic-assessment scope checked on 2026-09-03. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
